introduction.text: Forte Ostiense is a historic fort in Rome, built in the late 19th century as part of the city's defensive network and notable for its role in the Italian Resistance during World War II.

history.description: Rome's fortification system was built between 1877 and 1891.
Forte Ostiense was constructed between 1882 and 1884.
On 10 September 1943, Forte Ostiense was the site of a resistance action during the German occupation.
